title: Licensed Security Charged on a Delivered Event
content:
Licensed security on a Private Event & Banquet Services event is charged at the security rate per hour printed against the package.

1. Where the guests served pass the security threshold printed against the package, the rate is charged for the service hours included in the package together with the set-up lead hours printed against the same package, the doors being covered from set-up.
2. Where the guests served do not pass that security threshold but the count the delivered entry was guaranteed to does, the rate is charged for the service hours included in the package alone, the roster having been booked to the guarantee.
3. Where neither count passes that security threshold, no security stands on the bill.

A count standing exactly at the security threshold does not pass it.

## The figures each package prints

| Package | Security threshold, guests | Security rate, USD per hour | Service hours included | Set-up lead hours | First case, USD | Second case, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 0 | 0.0 | 0.5 | 0 | 0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 0 | 0 | 2.0 | 1.0 | 0 | 0 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 150 | 46 | 4.0 | 2.0 | 276 | 184 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 250 | 52 | 5.0 | 4.0 | 468 | 260 |
| Gala Reception Package | 400 | 58 | 6.0 | 6.0 | 696 | 348 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 500 | 55 | 10.0 | 8.0 | 990 | 550 |

## Illustration on hypothetical records

An event on the Seated Banquet Package whose delivered entry was guaranteed to 268 guests served 242 of them. The guests served do not pass the threshold of 250, but the count the delivered entry was guaranteed to does, so 52 for each hour over the 5.0 service hours included stands on the bill, that is 260. Had 263 guests been served, 52 over 5.0 and 4.0 hours together would stand, that is 468.
